red_boundary: The first commit succeeds, then the byte-identical request whose UTC CommittedAt differs from a microsecond boundary by exactly one 100-nanosecond tick must replay mutation-free.
privacy: The regression used only a fixture-owned disposable PostgreSQL database and synthetic canonical data; it made no provider, network, repository-source, ordinary-database, host, system, or Git change.
summary: The deterministic PostgreSQL RED reproduces r26 independently of DeepSeek and isolates timestamp precision as the replay conflict cause.
